summary: v8 auto-seed on /api/dashboard + /api/portfolio VERIFIED — 11/11 GREEN. Fresh authed user with zero rows hitting GET /api/dashboard triggers seed_user_starter automatically → revenue_mtd=$66,460.50, 4 recommendations returned (top-4 order unchanged: YouTube long-form, Ship It +18%, Bundle Notion, Diversify affiliate), and Mongo populated with the full Maya baseline (assets=8, recs=7, goals=4, notifications=6, content=4, chat_messages=4, strategy_plans=1). Same guarantee holds when a different fresh user calls GET /api/portfolio first (asset_count=8, total_revenue_mtd=$66,460.50). Idempotency verified: 4 repeat dashboard hits leave counts unchanged and rec titles/order identical. User compositions verified: POST /api/portfolio after auto-seed yields 9 assets (8 Maya + 1 custom) with total_revenue = $66,460.50 + custom.revenue_mtd, and both Maya-specific rows (Amazon+ConvertKit Affiliate, Notion Templates — Gumroad) remain. Per-user isolation holds: user A's auto-seed leaves B untouched (0 rows); B triggering later gets an independent copy with disjoint UUIDs. Auth gate intact: both endpoints return 401 without Bearer and with an invalid Bearer, confirming seed_user_starter runs INSIDE the endpoint AFTER current_user dependency. Other endpoints (/goals, /content, /recommendations, /notifications) still return empty for a truly fresh user — only /dashboard and /portfolio act as auto-seed front doors, as intended. Regression: POST /api/dev/reseed still works (returns {ok:true,user_id}, wipes and reseeds to counts=8/4/4/7/6/4/1); dashboard rec ordering still correct (priority tier then impact desc). No new bugs. Same pre-existing warnings carry over (FastAPI on_event deprecation, expo pointerEvents warning — both non-blocking, not v8-introduced).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:414 — GET /api/dashboard now calls `await seed_user_starter(user['user_id'])` BEFORE reading assets/recs. Idempotent guard at seed_user_starter:313 (`if await db.assets.count_documents({user_id})>0: return`) ensures no duplicate rows on repeat calls. Correct.
server.py:456 — GET /api/portfolio mirror of dashboard: same one-line auto-seed at top. Correct.

server.py:311-313 — Idempotency key is `assets.count_documents({user_id})>0`. This means if a user somehow has assets but is missing goals/recs/etc (partial seed), the function will NOT top up the missing collections. Not a regression from this change, but worth flagging: any user whose assets survived but whose other collections were wiped will remain in a partial state. Not observed in tests; noted for main agent awareness.
server.py:410,455 — seed_user_starter runs AFTER Depends(current_user) resolves, so unauth requests short-circuit to 401 before touching Mongo. Verified with 2 tests (no bearer, bad bearer). Correct.
No hardcoded URLs; tests read EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from env. All 11 tests use ephemeral user_v8_* users with teardown.
